The ability to observe, organize and write clearly, as well as the development of skills in the analysis of data and collaborations.

programs.title: Spanish
outcomes: Speak at the ACTFL (American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages) Proficiency Intermediate High Level.
Write at the ACTFL Intermediate High Level.
Listen and comprehend spoken discourse at the ACTFL Proficiency Intermediate High Level.
Read and comprehend written discourse at the ACTFL Intermediate High Level.
Explain and analyze more complex aspects of culture at the ACTFL Intermediate Range.

programs.title: Stand-up Forklift Safety
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to operate a stand-up forklift so that the overall operation is within  OSHA (Occupational Safety Health Administration) standards.
Demonstrate the ability to perform a stand-up forklift inspection.
Identify common workplace safety hazards and their mitigation.

programs.title: Studio Arts
outcomes: Discuss terminology appropriate to art and analyze artwork to explain how visual works of art communicate within a cultural context.
Evaluate and critique artwork using relevant terminology appropriate to studio art referencing contemporary and historical approaches.
Demonstrate and produce the visual elements and design principles in creating a work of art
Create a portfolio that demonstrates a clear individualized aesthetic with strong formal and conceptual content and exhibit such works in a public venue.

programs.title: Theater
outcomes: Examine and analyze key components of professional stage production, including all related performance, script, design, and technical considerations.
Identify and examine key theories, concepts and historical practices of theatre - both past and present.
Analyze and apply the fundamental elements of play structure and play analysis.
Develop and demonstrate intra- and inter-personal communication skills and theatrical best practices from involvement in creative, collaborative, and professional level theatrical productions.

programs.title: Theatre Arts
outcomes: Examine dramatic texts within any given genre and analyze them for meaning, themes, and social context.
Compare and contrast theories and techniques of acting through analysis of their historical and contemporary perspectives.
Analyze texts and scripts as they pertain to performance.
Skillfully use physical, vocal, emotional, and imaginative acting techniques, in performance.
Recognize standard practices of ensemble playing in a rehearsal/performance environment.
Compare and contrast theatrical periods and styles in terms of acting, directing, playwriting, and technical elements.
Apply technical processes, including lighting, set, costume, and/or stage make-up design, as they pertain to a given dramatic script.
Explore the impacts of dramatic performance and discuss the potential for theater to serve as an agent of social change.

programs.title: Workplace Readiness – Allied Health
outcomes: Demonstrate basic knowledge of vocabulary and basic medical terms necessary to be successful for successful transition to an allied health program.
Demonstrate the knowledge of various health care careers, their respective roles and responsibilities and required education and training requirements.
Demonstrate the integrated language skills necessary for communication in allied health courses.
